content: Please consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this medication and your specific health needs. How to Use: Before starting posaconazole or when refilling your prescription, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist, if available. This medication is typically administered as an injection into a vein, as directed by your doctor, usually once daily. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the medication if either is present. For optimal effectiveness, maintain a consistent level of the medication in your body. Side Effects: Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, abdominal pain, dizziness, or difficulty sleeping. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, posaconazole may cause severe (potentially fatal) liver disease. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are also rare. However, posaconazole can commonly cause a mild rash, which is usually not serious. It may be difficult to distinguish this from a rare rash that could indicate a severe allergic reaction. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for guidance. Precautions: Before using posaconazole, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other azole antifungals (e.g., ketoconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Posaconazole may affect heart rhythm (QT prolongation), and the risk may increase if you have certain medical conditions or are taking other medications that can cause QT prolongation. Low potassium or magnesium levels in the blood may also increase this risk, especially if you are using certain drugs (e.g., diuretics or water pills) or experiencing conditions like severe sweating, diarrhea, or vomiting. This medication may cause dizziness, and alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages and discuss marijuana use with your doctor. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Other medications may affect the removal of posaconazole from your body, potentially altering its effectiveness. Similarly, posaconazole may slow the removal of other drugs from your body, affecting how they work. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: Laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., kidney/liver function, blood mineral levels such as calcium, magnesium, potassium) should be conducted before starting this medication and periodically while using it. Attend all medical and laboratory appointments as scheduled. Missed Dose: It is important to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for proper storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
